results.title: East Bengal makes history in AFC Women's Champions League
results.content: The Kolkata team becomes the first Indian club to advance to the knockout stage of the elite competition

results.title: Bihar’s Ranivas Mound declared monument of national importance
results.content: Currently, 70 sites in Bihar are under the stewardship of the Archaeological Survey of India.

results.title: Gyanesh Kumar will soon be forced to step down, says K.C. Venugopal
results.content: AICC general secretary accuses Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah of using the Election Commission of India to undermine the Congress and influence electoral outcomes

results.title: From poverty alleviation to prosperity
results.content: India has reduced extreme poverty, but its high prosperity gap shows that millions remain far from a comfortable standard of living; informal work, stagnant wages and limited employment opportunities continue to constrain upward mobility

results.title: AIDSO protests against Congress government’s move to allow adoption of govt. schools by private institutions
results.content: Hundreds of students under the aegis of All India Democratic Students’ Organisation (AIDSO) staged a protest at Vivekananda Circle in Dharwad on Friday, condemning the State government’s move to allow adoption of government schools by private institutions and corporate companies
